title: おたよりの月別カット
lead: 4月から3月まで、月ごとの行事と季節を表す小さなカット12点です。保育園や学校のおたよりの見出し横や余白に使えます。
subject_en: Small monthly vignette illustrations for a school newsletter, each ONE compact scene or object cluster for one month of the Japanese school year, centred, simple flat colours. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: cherry blossoms with a school bag and a yellow hat
carp streamers and a small iris flower
an umbrella, rain boots and a hydrangea
a bamboo branch with paper strips and a small paddling pool
a paper fan, a goldfish bowl and a firework
a moon with pampas grass and a rice-ball plate
a relay baton, a ribbon medal and autumn leaves
an open picture book with fallen leaves and an acorn
a small Christmas tree, a wreath and a gift box
a kagami mochi rice cake, a pine decoration and a spinning top
a masu box of beans, a demon mask and a holly sprig
3月のカット(卒園・ひな祭り)
hina dolls, peach blossoms and a diploma tube
